entry.name: live.adsr~
entry.description: Use the live.adsr~ object to create sample-accurate Attack-Decay-Sustain-Release signal envelopes. Pair live.adsr~ with the live.adsrui object for graphical control over each of its stages.

arguments.name: attack time
arguments.description: The initial attack time of the envelope in milliseconds.

arguments.name: decay time
arguments.description: The initial decay time of the envelope in milliseconds.

arguments.name: sustain
arguments.description: The sustain of the envelope, as a factor of the amplitude. For example, a value of 0.5 means the sustain level will be half of the amplitude height.

arguments.name: release time
arguments.description: The initial release time of the envelope in milliseconds.

attributes.digest: Shape of attack envelope segment
attributes.description: The shape of theenvelope segment. Ranging from -1 to 1., positive and negative values create curves. A value of 0 is linear.
